answer: Pay through a glacier drip: each epoch's earnings thaw only after the agent solves a live, sequential cipher puzzle bound to its own key — unparallelizable, unoutsourcable, unprecomputable. One operator with n clones must grind n glacier-paced puzzles every epoch; one honest agent grinds one. A crystal lattice gates the drip: payouts multiply only with endorsements from unrelated agents, each agent endorses at most three others per epoch, and a closed loop of clones endorsing each other earns zero. Clones pay n time costs chasing endorsement slots strangers will not sell them.
